name: Think by Numbers
description: Minimizing suffering with the power of arithmetic

author.name: Mike P. Sinn
author.bio: Software engineer, economist, and professional spreadsheet enthusiast.
author.bioExtended: Uses causal inference and cost-benefit analysis to investigate why civilization keeps purchasing the expensive bad option.
author.mission: Created Think by Numbers and builds open-source health-data and clinical-research tools, including the Decentralized FDA. Also translated the Earth Repair Manual from the original alien.

podcast.title: Think by Numbers Podcast
podcast.subtitle: Data-driven analysis of government spending, economics, and public policy
podcast.description: The Think by Numbers podcast applies quantitative analysis to political and economic issues, cutting through partisan rhetoric with hard data. Each episode breaks down complex topics like government spending, corporate welfare, and tax policy into digestible, numbers-backed discussions.
